notes.title: Community Challenge Update: 25K Wishlists & 500 Discord Members!
notes.notes:
Gumshoes, you’ve done it again! Thanks to your incredible support, we’ve hit 25,000 Wishlists AND achieved our first Discord community milestone of 500 members!

Unlocked Rewards 🎉

✅ Steam Avatars – A set of Carmen Sandiego-themed avatars will be available for the community!
✅ 10% Deluxe Edition Discount on Launch – Steam players will now receive a launch discount on the Deluxe Edition.
✅ Discord Emotes – Our first batch of emotes is live in the server, with more on the way!
Keep the Chase Going!

Community Challenge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/2b289fd5711198c83f8d78e244695343d919238e.jpg

We’ve introduced a brand-new Discord Community Challenge, where more milestones mean more exclusive rewards for early members:

🔓 1.5K Members: Team Red Wallpaper
🔓 2K Members: Animated Emotes
🔓 5K Members: Game Team Q&A Video

And on the wishlist front, we’re getting closer to the next big reward:

🎉 65K Wishlists: In-game global festivals 🌸 will be introduced in future updates + a 15% Deluxe Edition discount on launch!
🎉100k Wishlists: Unlock a new Casual Carmen skin + a 20% Deluxe Edition discount on launch.


How to Participate

📌 Wishlist Carmen Sandiego on Steam to help us reach our next milestone.

📌 Join the Carmen Sandiego Discord and be part of an expanding community of sleuths!

📌 Spread the word! Every wishlist and new member helps unlock more rewards.

This is just the beginning, let’s keep the momentum going! 🕵️‍♀️🔎
For more information and updates, visit Carmen Sandiego Official Website and follow us on:

Instagram: @theofficialcarmensandiego
Twitter: @carmensandiego
Facebook: Carmen Sandiego


Til Next Crime.

notes.title: Community Challenge Update: 10K Achieved!
notes.notes:
We hit 10K Wishlists! Thanks to your support, the Team VILE Device Wallpaper is now available for download.

Get them below!

Desktop

Mobile

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/57cc8e160a31cbbc7e7dc305a3a3c86d340e37f9.jpg


Keep going, gumshoes! Let’s hit the next milestone! 🕵️‍♀️


HOW IT WORKS

We’ve set wishlist milestones for Carmen Sandiego. Each milestone comes with exclusive rewards for the community, adding even more excitement to the journey ahead.

By adding the game to your wishlist, you’ll help us hit these goals and unlock the rewards for everyone to enjoy when the game launches. Every wishlist counts—let’s hit these milestones together!

 

MILESTONE GOALS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/0d1cee6ce6aed3b4643325e8c27d9e9e2a644e81.jpg


 [strike]10,000 Wishlists: Unlock official Carmen Sandiego wallpapers for the community! [/strike]✅
 25,000 Wishlists: Unlock Carmen Sandiego-themed Steam avatars + a 10% deluxe edition discount on launch.
 65,000 Wishlists: Celebrate global festivals in-game like the Sakura Festival and Dia de los Muertos + a 15% deluxe edition discount on launch.
 100,000 Wishlists: Unlock a new Casual Carmen skin + a 20% deluxe edition discount on launch.

 

Important Notes

Festivals Update: Global festivals will be introduced in timed future updates, adding vibrant cultural events to the game.

Bonus Carmen Skin: This in game cosmetic will be unlocked for all players during the first major game update—no extra steps required!

 

HOW TO PARTICIPATE

[olist]
 Add Carmen Sandiego to your Steam wishlist.
 Spread the word! Share the news with friends and fellow fans to help us hit those milestones.
 Keep an eye on our social channels for updates on our progress and new announcements.
[/olist]

Are you ready to join the chase? Wishlist now and help us unlock amazing rewards!

For more information and updates, visit Carmen Sandiego Official Website and follow us on:

Instagram: @theofficialcarmensandiego
Twitter: @carmensandiego
